name: punnet
title: Punnet
description: A market stall on green display-grass matting: every product is a crate of white slats with its price in heavy black numerals on a fluorescent yellow starburst pegged into the top corner, the unit written just beneath it.

tokens.--font-poster: the heavy condensed face of the prices, the shop's name, the phone number, the category on a crate and the how-to-order heading
tokens.--font-body: the humanist sans of everything else: headings, product names, body text, labels
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of the small capital labels and of the category on a crate
tokens.--price-size: largest size of the price on a crate; the star, how far it stands above the crate and the gap between rows follow it; the product page scales it up
tokens.--tilt: how far the first star leans; the next three lean by other amounts, some the other way
tokens.--color-blade: the tufts of the matting, always darker than the background
tokens.--color-text: text set straight on the matting: page headings, introductions, links, the footer name
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the matting: dates, page numbers, the empty-list line, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: focus rings on the matting, and links there when pointed at
tokens.--color-card: the slats: crates, the name board, boards of page text, the how-to-order card; also the lettering of the sold-out label
tokens.--color-card-ink: text on the slats and focus rings there; the struck-out price and the label of a sold-out product
tokens.--color-card-muted: secondary text on the slats: product descriptions, small labels, quotations
tokens.--color-groove: nail heads on the slats and thin rules on them: table, list and opening-hours lines, the rule between text columns
tokens.--color-star: the starburst behind a price, the line under the phone number, and links on a board when pointed at
tokens.--color-off: the slats of a sold-out crate
tokens.--color-star-off: the star of a sold-out product, plain where the price is struck out; it stands out from the matting and from the dimmed slats
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-shadow: the hard shadow under slats, the name board and stars
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of page text and of the news list
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of slats, the sold-out label and code
tokens.--slat: the gap between two slats; also the thickness of the rule between text columns on the home page and of a horizontal rule in page text
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: under a date, between a product's name and its description, between opening-hours rows
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under a star, under a heading, between rows of details and table cells
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, the padding of slats, the gap between crates side by side, the space between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks: above page headings and section headings, the padding of a board of page text on wide screens, between text columns
tokens.--space-5: large gap: above the how-to-order card, under the page, between the two columns of a product
